changeinfo.changes:
The Hungry Horde™ 01.02
  • Added support for PlayStation®TV
  • Fixed a bug that could, under certain circumstances, cause leaderboards to be stuck on "retrieving" indefinitely
  • Fixed a rare bug where “MMM...brains” and “Lazy Developer” trophies would fail to fire the first time they were achieved
  • Added a jingle to the ingame minigame score screen
  • Added a show tips section to options
  • Added movie textures to drive through cinema scene
  • Rebalanced early stages to make the game a little easier for beginners
  • Fixed a bug where the Tank boss' tracks could flicker on and off
  • Fixed a rare bug where certain music would stop playing
  • Other minor fixes and improvements

The Hungry Horde™ 01.01
  • Accessing the leaderboards from an underage account displays the correct error messages
  • Connection problems when accessing the leaderboards now display the correct error messages
  • Fixed a rare bug where active zombies could become trapped in previous levels and fall out of the world
  • Fixed trophy unlock criteria for trophies; "Coconut Dodge, Gotta get 'em all, Doctors Orders" and "Mapmatician"
  • Fixed a problem with savedata recording the date incorrectly
